summary: XCF Global, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 4,000,000 shares of Class A common stock at $0.15 per share for gross proceeds of $600,000. The transaction was conducted with accredited investors under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). H.C. Wainwright and Roth Capital served as co-placement agents, receiving fees and warrants. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special-situation category.
